blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — The Police Regional Office 8 (PRO-8) in Palo, Leyte is rolling out a community-centered program aimed at making residents feel safe. Brig. Gen. Romano Cardiño, PRO-8 regional director, said the program called SAFE or Seen, Appreciated, Felt and Extraordinary Police Service, seeks to improve police visibility and responsiveness. “We should see one another, appreciate one another, and make our presence felt so that the community can say that they truly feel safe here in Eastern Visayas,” Cardiño said in an interview on Thursday, Oct.8.
